pages.text: Electrolysis runs in a chemical vat with $(item)two Electrode Holders$(), each holding a $(item)Copper$() or $(item)Zinc Electrode$() (you can mix them).$(br2)$(l)The build$()$(li)A $(item)Steel$() or $(item)Fireproof$() Chemical Vat. Cast iron does not work.

$(li)Machines must sit on the vat's own footprint, so two holders need a vat at least $(item)2x2$() wide.$(li)Both holders go $(item)on top$() of the vat.$(li)$(item)Heat 2$() under the vat: one burning $(item)Firebox$() is enough, or a superheated Blaze Burner.
Do not put an Industrial Mixer on this vat unless it is spinning at 30 RPM or more: any attached machine that is not working stops every recipe.

$(l)Getting electrodes$()$(br)Put a $(item)Block of Copper$() or a $(item)Block of Zinc$() in a $(item)Stonecutter$(): one block gives one electrode. Right-click a holder with an electrode to insert it. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it back.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
